regulations.title: Peraturan Presiden Nomor 46 Tahun 2025 tentang Perubahan Kedua atas Peraturan Presiden Nomor 16 Tahun 2018 tentang Pengadaan Barang/Jasa Pemerintah
obligations: PPK must hold competency certification matching procurement typology; where PPK is absent in Pemda APBD procurement, PA/KPA may assign a PPK-certified PPTK.
Provider RAB / commercial bid estimates must remain strictly distinct from official HPS determined by authorized PPK/PA/KPA.
Mandatory domestic product (PDN) and TKDN + BMP layering priority (Pasal 66) and minimum 40% budget allocation for domestic UMKK products.
regulations.licensing_boundary: Public statutory regulation; verify latest LKPP implementing regulations (PerLKPP) per tender.

regulations.title: Peraturan Presiden Nomor 95 Tahun 2018 tentang Sistem Pemerintahan Berbasis Elektronik (SPBE)
obligations: Establishes national SPBE governance, management, audit, and 6 Architecture Domains: Proses Bisnis, Data dan Informasi, Infrastruktur SPBE, Aplikasi SPBE, Keamanan SPBE, and Layanan SPBE.

regulations.title: Peraturan Presiden Nomor 132 Tahun 2022 tentang Arsitektur Sistem Pemerintahan Berbasis Elektronik Nasional
obligations: Operationalizes the 6 SPBE Architecture Domains across ministries, agencies, and regional governments (K/L/Pemda) aligned with national SPBE roadmap.

regulations.title: Peraturan Presiden Nomor 39 Tahun 2019 tentang Satu Data Indonesia
obligations: Government data must satisfy Data Standards, Metadata, Data Interoperability, and Reference Codes / Master Data.

regulations.title: Undang-Undang Nomor 27 Tahun 2022 tentang Pelindungan Data Pribadi (UU PDP)
obligations: Classify Specific (Pasal 4(2)) vs General (Pasal 4(3)) Personal Data; record lawful basis (Pasal 20); honor Subject Rights (Pasal 5-13); maintain ROPA (Pasal 31) and DPIA (Pasal 34); notify breaches within 3x24 hours (Pasal 46); enforce cross-border transfer cascade (Pasal 56); administrative fines up to 2% annual revenue (Pasal 57).
regulations.licensing_boundary: Public statutory regulation; enacted 2022-10-17 with full compliance per Pasal 74 on 2024-10-17.

regulations.title: Peraturan Otoritas Jasa Keuangan Nomor 11/POJK.03/2022 tentang Penyelenggaraan Teknologi Informasi oleh Bank Umum
obligations: Governs commercial bank IT Governance, IT Architecture & RSTI, IT Risk Management, Cyber Security, Vendor/PPJTI outsourcing, Data/PDP, and Data Center / DRC placement.
regulations.licensing_boundary: Public sectoral regulation; read alongside implementing PADK OJK 1/2026.

regulations.title: Peraturan Anggota Dewan Komisioner OJK Nomor 1 Tahun 2026 tentang Penyelenggaraan Teknologi Informasi oleh Bank Umum
obligations: Enacted 23 January 2026, effective 1 March 2026 as technical implementing regulation for POJK 11/POJK.03/2022 (revoking SEOJK 21/SEOJK.03/2017).

Strengthens Board/Komite Pengarah TI accountability, IT Architecture & RSTI stages, cyber risk controls, PPJTI vendor due diligence & materiality re-assessment (including offshore supervision access), PDP alignment, and DC/DRC licensing/reporting.

regulations.title: Surat Edaran OJK Nomor 21/SEOJK.03/2017 tentang Penerapan Manajemen Risiko dalam Penggunaan Teknologi Informasi oleh Bank Umum
obligations: REVOKED effective 2026-03-01 by PADK OJK No. 1 Tahun 2026. Do not cite as active controlling banking regulation.

regulations.title: Indeks Keamanan Informasi (Indeks KAMI) — Badan Siber dan Sandi Negara (BSSN)
obligations: Assesses Electronic System category, Security Governance, Risk Management, Framework, Asset Management, Technology, plus Cloud, Third-Party, and PDP supplements. Verify exact client-mandated workbook version before scoring.
regulations.licensing_boundary: Official BSSN public instrument; lock exact active assessment version per engagement.

regulations.title: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Information Security, Cybersecurity and Privacy Protection — Information Security Management Systems
obligations: Requires ISMS Clauses 4-10 (Context, Leadership, Planning, Support, Operation, Performance Evaluation, Improvement) plus Statement of Applicability (SoA) across 93 Annex A controls (37 Organizational, 8 People, 14 Physical, 34 Technological) with inclusion/exclusion justifications.
regulations.licensing_boundary: Copyrighted ISO/IEC standard: summarize structure and map controls legitimately; never reproduce full licensed standard text.

regulations.title: COBIT 2019 Framework: Governance and Management Objectives
obligations: 40 Governance and Management Objectives across 5 domains (EDM01-05, APO01-14, BAI01-11, DSS01-06, MEA01-04). Process Capability (0-5 per objective) must not be conflated with Focus Area Maturity (0-5 systemic aggregate).
regulations.licensing_boundary: Copyrighted ISACA framework: apply methodology and reference objective IDs without reproducing proprietary full text.

regulations.title: The TOGAF Standard, 10th Edition
obligations: ADM lifecycle (Preliminary, Phases A-H, Requirements Management), Business/Data/Application/Technology domains, ABB vs SBB distinction, and Architecture Governance / Compliance Review. Map to 6 SPBE domains for Indonesian public sector.
regulations.licensing_boundary: Copyrighted Open Group standard: use methodology and reference concepts without verbatim full-text reproduction.
